purpose: Cover US-18001 (Readiness as tab 1 and the PRD rename, plus the live-client resync SSOT guard added for issue 297) and US-18101 (shared pill, findings-list and diff components). Shares the readiness fixture builders with TS-222 so the tab and the CLI assertions ride the same shapes.
title: Readiness tab layout, PRD rename and shared pill, findings-list and diff components

testCases.description: First tab button is Readiness, second is PRD; the PRD panel contains the former Overview body unchanged.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18001-1 tab order and PRD rename

testCases.description: The two verdict pills carry formatVerdictLines(result) strings as labels; variant pins the verdict family and the value class carries yes/no.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18001-2 verdict pill labels equal formatVerdictLines

testCases.description: Each PO blocker id appears in the questions table under its question group with the id as an anchor link into the document tabs.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18001-3 PO blocker ids appear in the questions table

testCases.description: With a profile register of productOwner, the questions table precedes the blocking table and both carry every blocker id.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18001-4 register orders the questions and blocking tables

testCases.description: Under any register, every PO blocker id and every engineer blocker id appears somewhere in the DOM.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18001-5 no blocker id is omitted from the DOM

testCases.description: When levels.readyToBuild.ok is false the freeze state block names the failing gates from levels.readyToBuild.blockedBy in plain words and no freeze control is rendered.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18001-6 freeze state names failing gates in plain words, no freeze control

testCases.description: Walking the rendered anchors and matching against the --json for the same tree hash: every id on the tab is present in the JSON.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18001-7 every id on the tab appears in the CLI --json for the same tree

testCases.description: pill renders the same markup shape with a per-value vocabulary class for a gate state, a level verdict, a persona and an AC class.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18101-1 pill emits one shape with per-value vocabulary classes

testCases.description: findingsList called with identical inputs from the Readiness and Product Map call paths returns byte-identical markup.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18101-2 findingsList is byte-identical across call sites

testCases.description: No existing Product Map or Requirements test expectation changes; only the Readiness-specific additions land.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-tab.test.js::readiness tab: AC-18101-3 existing Product Map and Requirements tests retain their expectations

testCases.description: resyncTabsAfterSwap keeps tab-readiness as the sole visible panel when Readiness is aria-selected and the swap left tab-overview visible (the Phase 3.6 server default). Pins issue 297: before the fix, the hard-coded TABS list in live-client.js omitted 'readiness', indexOf returned -1, selected fell back to overview, and both tab-readiness and tab-overview went visible.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/live-client.test.js::AC-18001-8 resyncTabsAfterSwap keeps Readiness visible on the embed-no-hash default (issue 297)

testCases.description: resyncTabsAfterSwap honours every nav.tabs [role=tab][data-tab] the server rendered as the SSOT for the tab list. Iterating the six main tabs with each as aria-selected and the swap-default visible panel set to tab-overview, exactly the aria-selected tab's panel is visible after resync. Guards against future drift: a seventh tab added to the renderer survives a swap without an edit on live-client.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/live-client.test.js::AC-18001-8 resyncTabsAfterSwap preserves every tab the DOM renders (SSOT invariant)

testCases.description: resyncTabsAfterSwap preserves product-map as the sole visible panel through a swap. Guards the one tab that the pre-issue-297 TABS list did include, so the SSOT rewrite does not regress the behaviour it previously had right.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/live-client.test.js::AC-18001-8 resyncTabsAfterSwap preserves Product Map through a swap (regression guard)
